name: Bigger Basket
rule: Your basket holds 6 specimens instead of 4.

name: Field Guide
rule: Roll two dice and keep the better result.

name: Mushroom Knife
rule: Ignore the first hazard you draw on each trip. It doesn't count toward a bust.

name: Grow Tent
rule: Pitch it on one square. The bed there ignores its season window and Cold Snap. Moving it is a Tend action.

name: Dehydrator
rule: Stored mushrooms no longer spoil when the season changes.

name: Lantern
rule: Opens the Old-growth: Lion's Mane, Reishi and Porcini.

name: Trail Map
rule: Opens the Burn Scar in spring: Morels, and plenty of hazards.

name: Blight Spray
rule: Clearing blight treats every blighted bed at once, for 1 action.

name: Drip Line
rule: Waters every bed each month, so you never need to Water. Dry spells don't stall it.

name: Waders
rule: Opens the Riverbank from spring to fall: Dryad's Saddle, Shaggy Mane and oysters on the willows.

name: Compass
rule: Opens the Hollow in fall and winter: Blewits, Truffles and other deep-woods finds.

name: Spade
rule: Dig under a turned card of plain ground on your way home. Under oak or hazel in winter, now and then: a truffle.
